name: J-released-extra (200 prompts)
convention_evidence: Public producer calls unmodified jlens.fit with max_seq_len=128 and default source/target/skip conventions. Inspected upstream HEAD predates this release and verifies those conventions. Artifact keys independently verify layers, width and prompt count.
provenance_limit: The artifact does not embed a fitting-command, model-weight revision, or jlens revision. Public producer code is evidence of intended conventions, not a cryptographic record of execution.
corpus: WikiText-103 train; heading/empty-line filtering and >=600-character buffers, truncated at 128 tokens, per public make_prompts.py
comparison_limit: Extra baseline only: different corpus preparation, 200 prompts versus 16 local source prompts, BF16 producer and FP16 storage. Casting to fp32 does not restore lost precision.
